tagline: A daily serum designed to strengthen the skin barrier, build lasting resilience, and leave skin calm, hydrated and balanced.
description: Designed for everyday use, URBAN DEFENSE SERUM helps strengthen the skin barrier and support lasting resilience. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing formula delivers hydration while helping keep skin calm, balanced and comfortable, making it suitable for daily use in humid conditions.
image_alt: EMBRAE Urban Defense Serum, 30 ml serum bottle
benefits: Leaves skin calm, hydrated and balanced
routine_text: Add Reset, Adapt and Protect to complete the routine.
essentials_heading: Urban Defense Serum, at a glance.

howto.title: Pump
howto.text: Dispense 1–2 pumps onto clean, dry skin.

howto.title: Pat
howto.text: Gently press and pat into your face and neck until fully absorbed.

inci: Aqua, Propanediol, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Glycerin, Euxyl 9010 (Phenoxyethanol and Ethylhexylglycerin), Centella Asiatica Extract, Saccharide Isomerate (Pentavitin), Ectoin, Betaine, Trehalose, Ceramide NP (and) Ceramide AP (and) Ceramide EOP (and) Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Beta-Sitosterol, Beta-Glucan, Carbomer, Allantoin, Sodium PCA, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid.
storage:
Storage instructions
Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from direct sunlight and high temperatures.

Caution
Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water.

Note
Perform a patch test before use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

For external use only.
